summary: Every shared setting, asked once, at the only moment the questions are live.
invariants: MINE vs OURS is the whole safety model. A `mine` setting is what I broadcast — I decide alone, either of us stops alone, and turning it on does NOT turn it on for them. An `ours` setting requires both.
set() has no parameter for the other person. One person cannot configure a pair.
an unanswered partner is NOT a yes — not answering is not an answer
either side ends a shared setting alone, instantly

PRESENCE DEFAULTS ON (v0.25.0, owner direction). I shipped it off, reasoning that watching a cursor is a lot — that reasoning was about a STRANGER. For two people who deliberately paired, off-by-default means the app starts cold and stays cold. The GUARANTEE did not change: still two-sided, still stoppable alone, still never persisted.
READ RECEIPTS STAY OFF. "Seen at 11:04 and said nothing" is a different kind of information from where a cursor is, and it is the one that gets used against people.
asked once; skipping is a real outcome and the defaults stand
every setting states WHAT IT COSTS under its label — a switch whose consequence you have to guess is not a choice
